ui_bugs.issue: handleExportImage and handleGenerateShareLink capture 1x1 pixel placeholder instead of full session content. Captured image in shared session is only 118 bytes (1x1 PNG).
ui_bugs.root_cause: The sessionContentRef element has overflow-y-auto and max-h-[calc(90vh-180px)] which limits the visible area. html2canvas only captures visible portion of scrollable containers, not the full scrolled content.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Before capturing: 1) Remove overflow/max-height constraints temporarily, 2) Set element to full height, 3) Capture, 4) Restore original styles. Alternatively, use scrollWidth/scrollHeight option in html2canvas or clone element with full expansion.

rca_of_the_issue.issue: html2canvas captures 1x1 pixel placeholder instead of full session content
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The element being captured (sessionContentRef at line 754) has CSS class 'overflow-y-auto max-h-[calc(90vh-180px)]'. When html2canvas captures a scrollable element with constrained height, it only captures the visible viewport portion, not the full scrolled content. If the element is initially empty or scrolled, only a tiny portion is captured.
reproduction_steps: 1. Open Session Editor for any session
3. html2canvas attempts to capture sessionContentRef element
4. Due to overflow constraints, only visible tiny area is captured
5. Resulting image is 1x1 pixel or very small
mitigation_steps: 1. Before html2canvas capture, clone the element to an offscreen container
2. Remove overflow and max-height constraints from the clone
Alternative: Use html2canvas options like width: element.scrollWidth, height: element.scrollHeight
